title: Shopping source of truth (NPC → purchase/exchange options)
description: Hand-edited. One entry per (NPC, item, kind) purchase option. materials.ts synthesizes every option into a route at load and merges it with the recipes make/gather/quest routes (single read path, no positional zip). NPC keys are dynamic; option shape is strict (additionalProperties false) so typos fail validation. Editors pick this up via the $schema pointer in shops.json.

town.description: Primary town label. Informational only — routes keep their own town.

kind.description: Omit for shop (counter purchase). Spell out barter for NPC exchanges. Same-name repeats = distinct options.

scope.description: Who the cap binds. account covers the old 伺服器-suffixed caps (in today's data exactly the perChar=false rows) and any future per-account cap. Omit for character.

amount.description: What you pay. Gold = per single item (total = amount × qty); item tokens = per whole exchange (total = amount × ceil(qty / get.amount)). Null = unfilled (gold only — token costs always known from routes; enforced by pnpm test:shops).

currency.description: Omit for gold. Otherwise an item token name (e.g. 魔物討伐證明). Check script warns on unknown token names.

get.description: What you receive per exchange. Omit when 1 (the common case). Canonical home for outQty — the overlay writes it back onto routes.

limit.description: Omit entirely when uncapped. Omitted times = uncapped (a bare 1 must be written out); period defaults to daily when times is present, and is rejected without times.
